name: Lambda Cloud
summary: GPU cloud for on-demand instances, 1-Click Clusters and filesystems, with a public Cloud API. Public instance prices change on 16 Nov 2026.
description: Commercial GPU cloud (lambda.com; formerly also reached via lambda.ai / lambdalabs.com, which 301 to lambda.com). Established provider gap fill, not a claim of a brand-new launch. Public Cloud products documented: On-Demand Cloud (ODC) Linux GPU VMs, 1-Click Clusters (1CCs), and filesystems. Instances can run customer workloads (code execution). Lambda docs warn that cryptocurrency mining is prohibited. Pricing page: “Clear, straightforward pricing for Instances, 1-Click Clusters™, and Superclusters,” plus reserved-capacity sales. The public on-demand instance tables carry this notice: “These prices take effect November 16, 2026, at 00:00 UTC” (2026-11-16 01:00 Europe/Stockholm). “Until then, log in to your Lambda Cloud account to see current pricing.” Those upcoming public examples include 1x NVIDIA B200 SXM6 $7.99/GPU/hr, H100 SXM $4.89, H100 PCIe $3.79, GH200 $2.59, A100 PCIe 40GB $1.99, plus tax/VAT/GST. 1-Click Cluster examples on the same page (2 weeks–1 year): NVIDIA HGX B200 16 GPUs $9.86/GPU/hr, 64 GPUs $9.36, 256+ $8.87; NVIDIA H100 16 GPUs $6.16, 64 $5.85, 256 $5.54. Billing docs: ODC is priced by hourly usage and billed in one-minute increments from the moment an instance passes health checks until it is terminated, including idle running time; weekly invoices. 1CCs are priced per GPU-hour and billed weekly under the reservation; invoice due in ten days after approval. Filesystems billed per GiB-month in one-hour increments (the $0.20/GiB/month figure in the docs is labeled an example, not current list price). No ingress/egress charge is documented. Refunds are issued as service credits toward future Lambda Cloud usage, not cash, expiring 12 months after issue. A hosted OpenAI-compatible inference API was not found; the Cloud API (https://docs.lambda.com/api/cloud) manages accounts, keys, instances and related resources (rate-limited). Auth is a Lambda Cloud API key (not created). SSO is documented for the console. Legal: https://lambda.com/legal/privacy-policy and https://lambda.com/legal/terms-of-service (200). Bare /privacy and /terms 404. license proprietary; pricing paid. No signup or spend was used.

agent_access.notes: Lambda Cloud API key or console login required (not created). Cloud API manages instances; no hosted OpenAI-compatible inference API was found. Public on-demand prices on lambda.com/pricing take effect 2026-11-16 00:00 UTC; current prices require a logged-in account. Instances execute customer workloads.
